datasets.title: sentinel_polar (synthetic drone, with ground truth)
datasets.note: The MATLAB repo's dataset25 photos with the dataset_sentinel_gt silhouettes as ground truth. Level cameras on a ring at 10 degree steps.

datasets.title: reaper_polar (synthetic drone, no ground truth)
datasets.note: Synthetic polar renders (290x400 shrunk to 232x320, the height of the sentinel images). Same camera ring as sentinel_polar, with this set's own starting values: camera distance 150, focal 450, level cameras, a starting box 25 wide, 60 deep and 80 tall; the run settings (Chan-Vese, CFL update, smoothing 0.386, re-init every 5 / step 0.5) are those of the saved 'reaper 2d interactions' session. There are no ground-truth silhouettes, so IoU, false positives/negatives and RMS error are not available.

datasets.title: zebra (real photos, no ground truth)
datasets.note: Real turntable photos (684x461 originals shrunk to 320x216). There are no silhouettes, so IoU, false positives/negatives and RMS error are not available. Settings tuned by hand for this set: camera distance 300, focal 500, level cameras, a starting box 82 wide, 150 deep and 95 tall turned by -5 degrees. Use the up / x / y shift (or the Move box tool in an opened view) to place the box. A depth of 150 fills the whole volume in y, so the surface cannot grow further that way.
